cards.back:
The food you need to grow and stay healthy.
Bahasa Indonesia: gizi
Example: Good nutrition helps children grow strong and think clearly.
cards.say: nutrition. The food you need to grow and stay healthy. Good nutrition helps children grow strong and think clearly.

cards.back:
Having the right amounts of different things.
Bahasa Indonesia: seimbang
Example: A balanced meal has vegetables, protein and some rice.
cards.say: balanced. Having the right amounts of different things. A balanced meal has vegetables, protein and some rice.

cards.back:
Physical activity that keeps your body strong.
Bahasa Indonesia: olahraga
Example: Regular exercise makes your heart and muscles healthier.
cards.say: exercise. Physical activity that keeps your body strong. Regular exercise makes your heart and muscles healthier.

cards.back:
The strength to keep doing something for a long time.
Bahasa Indonesia: daya tahan
Example: Running every morning gave her the stamina to finish the race.
cards.say: stamina. The strength to keep doing something for a long time. Running every morning gave her the stamina to finish the race.

cards.back:
Harm done to part of the body.
Bahasa Indonesia: cedera
Example: A knee injury kept him out of the football match.
cards.say: injury. Harm done to part of the body. A knee injury kept him out of the football match.

cards.back:
A strip of cloth wrapped around a wound to protect it.
Bahasa Indonesia: perban
Example: The nurse wrapped a clean bandage around my sore wrist.
cards.say: bandage. A strip of cloth wrapped around a wound to protect it. The nurse wrapped a clean bandage around my sore wrist.

cards.back:
An illness caused by tiny germs getting into the body.
Bahasa Indonesia: infeksi
Example: Wash a cut well so it does not get an infection.
cards.say: infection. An illness caused by tiny germs getting into the body. Wash a cut well so it does not get an infection.

cards.back:
A medicine that helps protect you from a serious disease.
Bahasa Indonesia: vaksin
Example: The doctor gave every child a vaccine at the clinic.
cards.say: vaccine. A medicine that helps protect you from a serious disease. The doctor gave every child a vaccine at the clinic.

cards.back:
A sign in the body that shows you are ill.
Bahasa Indonesia: gejala
Example: A cough is a common symptom of a cold.
cards.say: symptom. A sign in the body that shows you are ill. A cough is a common symptom of a cold.

cards.back:
Keeping yourself and things clean to stay healthy.
Bahasa Indonesia: kebersihan diri
Example: Good hygiene means washing your hands before every meal.
cards.say: hygiene. Keeping yourself and things clean to stay healthy. Good hygiene means washing your hands before every meal.

cards.back:
A natural substance in food that your body needs in small amounts.
Bahasa Indonesia: vitamin
Example: Oranges are full of vitamin C, which helps your body heal cuts and stay healthy.
cards.say: vitamin. A natural substance in food that your body needs in small amounts. Oranges are full of vitamin C, which helps your body heal cuts and stay healthy.

cards.back:
A unit that measures the energy in food.
Bahasa Indonesia: kalori
Example: A bowl of fruit has fewer calories than a large cake.
cards.say: calorie. A unit that measures the energy in food. A bowl of fruit has fewer calories than a large cake.

cards.back:
A note from a doctor that allows you to get a medicine.
Bahasa Indonesia: resep dokter
Example: The pharmacist read the prescription before giving us the medicine.
cards.say: prescription. A note from a doctor that allows you to get a medicine. The pharmacist read the prescription before giving us the medicine.

cards.back:
To become well or strong again after an illness.
Bahasa Indonesia: pulih
Example: It took a week for him to recover from the flu.
cards.say: recover. To become well or strong again after an illness. It took a week for him to recover from the flu.

cards.back:
A feeling of being very tired.
Bahasa Indonesia: kelelahan
Example: After the long hike, fatigue made her legs feel heavy.
cards.say: fatigue. A feeling of being very tired. After the long hike, fatigue made her legs feel heavy.

cards.back:
A part of the body that lets you move by tightening and relaxing.
Bahasa Indonesia: otot
Example: Swimming builds strong muscle in your arms and back.
cards.say: muscle. A part of the body that lets you move by tightening and relaxing. Swimming builds strong muscle in your arms and back.

cards.back:
The way you hold your body when you sit or stand.
Bahasa Indonesia: postur tubuh
Example: Sit up straight to keep good posture while you write.
cards.say: posture. The way you hold your body when you sit or stand. Sit up straight to keep good posture while you write.

cards.back:
A body reaction to something that is harmless to most people.
Bahasa Indonesia: alergi
Example: My brother has an allergy to peanuts, so he checks every label.
cards.say: allergy. A body reaction to something that is harmless to most people. My brother has an allergy to peanuts, so he checks every label.

cards.back:
Not having enough water in the body.
Bahasa Indonesia: kekurangan cairan
Example: Footballers get dehydrated if they do not drink enough in the heat.
cards.say: dehydrated. Not having enough water in the body. Footballers get dehydrated if they do not drink enough in the heat.

cards.back:
The part of the body that fights germs and disease.
Bahasa Indonesia: sistem kekebalan tubuh
Example: Sleep and good food help your immune system stay strong.
cards.say: immune system. The part of the body that fights germs and disease. Sleep and good food help your immune system stay strong.

cards.back:
To hurt a joint by twisting it suddenly.
Bahasa Indonesia: terkilir
Example: She slipped on the wet step and sprained her ankle.
cards.say: sprain. To hurt a joint by twisting it suddenly. She slipped on the wet step and sprained her ankle.

cards.back:
A visit to a doctor to see that you are healthy.
Bahasa Indonesia: pemeriksaan kesehatan
Example: We have a dental checkup at the clinic every six months.
cards.say: checkup. A visit to a doctor to see that you are healthy. We have a dental checkup at the clinic every six months.

cards.back:
To rest and let your body and mind become calm.
Bahasa Indonesia: bersantai
Example: Listening to quiet music helps me relax after a busy day.
cards.say: relax. To rest and let your body and mind become calm. Listening to quiet music helps me relax after a busy day.
